decisions.reason: As a new finish variant in the firm's core drainage range, it is likely to be retained, though its weaker website prominence suggests somewhat higher discontinuation risk than the flagship launches.
A shower channel for seamless coverings fits current bathroom installation trends and its dedicated product page indicates a meaningful commercial commitment.
The pump-assisted drainage solution serves a narrower, more technical niche, so it carries the highest rationalization risk despite still fitting the firm's drainage specialization.
A tileable floor drain with grating is a close-to-core product with broad application potential, and the standalone page suggests the firm intends to build it as part of the range.
The stainless steel design grate is a complementary design-led variant that is likely to stay in the catalog, supported by its own page and fit with established drain systems.
